actions.text: Grab Selected sends the selected ids to the bulk grab call.
Remove Selected opens a confirmation dialog; confirming sends the selected ids to the bulk delete call and closes the dialog.
Import Selected opens interactive import for the download ids of the selected completed items.
A row's Grab button grabs that single queue item.
A row's remove button (Remove from queue) opens the remove dialog; confirming removes that item.
A row's interactive import button opens interactive import for that item's download.
In the remove dialog the user picks a removal method and a blocklist method, then clicks Remove or Close.
The user can select a filter, sort by a column, change table options and page size, and change page.
The select-all checkbox selects or unselects all rows.

rules.text: Grab Selected is disabled unless something is selected and at least one selected item has status 'delay'.
Remove Selected is disabled when nothing is selected; Import Selected is disabled when nothing is selected or no selected item is completed.
A row's Grab button shows only for items with status 'delay' or 'downloadClientUnavailable'; the interactive import button shows only for completed items with tracked download status 'warning'.
The maximum page size in table options is 200; changing page size returns to page 1.
The queue is fetched from /queue with page, page size, sort key, sort direction and the selected filters; total pages is at least 1.
Episodes are loaded for the unique episode ids of the queue records; the table shows once episodes are fetched, or when there are no records or none have episodes.
The visible page is not re-rendered while a remove or import dialog is open.
In the remove dialog, Change category is disabled unless the download client has a post-import category, and Ignore is disabled unless the series and episodes are known.
For pending items the removal method choice is hidden and Blocklist and search is disabled.
The Refresh command is ignored if the same command was run within the last 5 seconds.
Page number resets to 1 when navigating back (POP).
Queue status count is the total count when unknown-series items are included, otherwise the count.

shows.text: The page is headed Activity / Queue and lists queue items in a table with a pager showing page, total pages and total records.
While loading and not yet populated, a loading indicator is shown.
When loading is finished and the queue or episodes request failed, an error alert shows the 'QueueLoadError' message.
When there are no records, a message shows: 'QueueFilterHasNoItems' if a filter other than 'all' is selected and the queue status count is above 0, otherwise 'QueueIsEmpty'.
The toolbar has Refresh, Grab Selected, Remove Selected, Import Selected, Options buttons and a filter menu with custom filters of type queue.

Each row has a selection checkbox and shows only the visible columns: status, series, episode, episode title, air date, languages, quality, custom formats, custom format score, protocol, indexer, download client, title, size, output path, time left, progress, added, actions.
The series cell links to the series if it is known; otherwise it shows the release title.
The episode cell shows '-' when there are no episodes, the season number for a full season, a single episode number, or a first-to-last episode range.
The episode title cell shows '-' without episodes or series, a link for one episode, or a 'Multiple Episodes' popover listing titles for several.

The time-left cell shows an info tooltip for delayed items (delaying until) and for download-client-unavailable items (retrying on); '-' if no time left or status is completed or failed; otherwise the formatted time left with remaining/total size as hover title.
The progress cell shows a progress bar with percentage (one decimal) when progress is non-zero.
The remove dialog title and message vary by whether it is for one named item, one selected item, or several selected items.

sideEffects.text: Successful bulk or single remove and grab calls invalidate the cached queue so it reloads.
Remove calls send the chosen removal method and blocklist method as query string, using DELETE.
Choosing removal or blocklist options in the dialog saves them as queue options.
Refresh posts a command to /command and stores the returned command.
The page registers a page populator that refetches the queue, removed on leaving.
